purpose: Fail-closed CI/CD and software-supply-chain evidence gate bound to one exact commit.
required_controls: each gate has its own exact-SHA evidence bound to the same commit
exact dependency lock file + independent verification
build provenance binds commit, lock, SBOM and artifact
human approval if auditing a production release candidate
closure_rule: Synthetic PASS validates the auditor only. H-05 remains OPEN until a real CI run on the exact repository commit passes all gates and supply-chain verification.
